info.title: CouponHub HTTP API and form contracts
info.description: Actual PHP routes. Session cookie authentication, CSRF on every write. Browser form endpoints may return redirects/HTML; JSON APIs are explicitly marked. No bearer JWT is required. OAuth/Resend/ACCESSTRADE real-provider acceptance requires your credentials.
